systemTypography.navigation: Native large titles for Activity, Settings, and pairing; inline detail and editor titles. Conversation hides its navigation bar; tabs and the named composer provide context.
systemTypography.symbols: SF Symbols; send arrow uses .body semibold, capped at Dynamic Type xxxLarge for the icon only.
systemTypography.scaling: System Dynamic Type; no custom fixed font sizes, line-height scale, or custom typeface.
systemTypography.fontSizeSerialization: fontSize omitted from frontmatter so a web CSS size cannot replace semantic native text styles.

nativeLayout.screenModel: Scrolling iPhone layouts; no breakpoint or fixed canvas model.
nativeLayout.listAndForm: System default styling; no custom list row geometry or sheet detents.
nativeLayout.background: PastoralBackground fills the viewport and ignores safe areas and hit testing; controls retain native safe areas.

nativeComponents.name: Root Navigation
behavior: Conversation tag 0, Activity tag 1, Settings tag 2; initial selection is 1.
Activity badge counts needsConfirmation or due reminders and available check-ins.
No pairing presents PairingView instead of tabs.
Conversation has no duplicate navigation header. Memories and Journal remain under Settings.

nativeComponents.name: Connection Status
behavior: Refreshes the model when tapped.
Connected uses a FieldStyle.olive circle.fill icon and ordinary ink text.
Offline uses FieldStyle.ink text and wifi.slash.
nativeComponents.accessibilityHint: Checks your connection to the Mac
nativeComponents.location: Settings → Mac connection; offline notices remain in Activity and Conversation.

nativeComponents.name: Pairing Field
behavior: Autocapitalization and autocorrection disabled.
Connect to Mac disabled while working or when the link is empty.

nativeComponents.name: Prominent Action
nativeComponents.shape: Native default unless a view explicitly sets buttonBorderShape.
behavior: Connect to Mac uses full width and minHeight 44.
Native disabled and focus behavior.

nativeComponents.name: Reminder Card
behavior: Draft and paused show Not scheduled yet, Confirm reminder, and Edit.
Due shows Mark done; closed reminders do not show the actions menu.
Date, time, UTC offset, and stored time-zone identifier are live model content.
Text and controls remain native, not part of the image.

nativeComponents.name: Reminder Confirmation
behavior: Confirm action sends the current reminder revision.
Disabled when model.canAct is false.
Confirm uses the explicit control radius; Mark done retains the system shape.

nativeComponents.name: Conversation Composer
nativeComponents.nativeType: TextField(axis: .vertical) and plain Button sharing one surface in safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0)
behavior: Native keyboard avoidance through safeAreaInset.
Interactive scroll dismisses the keyboard.
Send disabled when offline/unavailable, sending, pending, or empty.
Source identifier messageComposer; send has explicit Send message accessibility label.

send.dynamicTypeUpperBound: xxxLarge (symbol only; text remains fully scalable)

nativeComponents.name: User Message
behavior: Full available width, leading alignment.
Saved text is selectable; companion replies stay on the open page ground.

nativeComponents.name: Native Editing and Settings
behavior: Reminder and memory editors use NavigationStack and inline titles.

implemented: Native Dynamic Type text styles and SF Symbols.
Adaptive light/dark ink, ground, and olive.
Explicit labels for icon-only Send, Memories, and reminder menu.
Text plus symbols accompany status colors.
Selectable conversation, journal, and Mac-address text.
Native keyboard, focus, forms, dialogs, and navigation behavior.
Reminder title and time zone can grow vertically.
Background wash strengthens for Increased Contrast and Reduce Transparency.
limits: No custom Reduce Motion branch; no custom app animations are defined.
44-point frames are present on explicit custom icon actions and many text actions; this is not a claim of universal audited target coverage.
This extraction is documentation, not a new VoiceOver or physical-device verification pass.

notes: Frontmatter owns primitive values. RGB percentages preserve the SwiftUI normalized component values without 8-bit rounding.
No synthetic tonal ramps: none are implemented in the native app.
No HTML/CSS component previews: nativeComponents preserves the real SwiftUI system and avoids asserting a web recreation as authority.
No custom shadows, motion tokens, or breakpoints exist; the empty extension arrays are intentional.
System chrome appearance varies with iOS; do not copy a screenshot silhouette into custom controls.
The paper color token is foreground on charcoal reminder buttons; the reminder surface is the ReminderPaper raster.
September 28 full-page update: Settings → Mac connection contains maintenance and destructive pairing controls; native action behavior is unchanged.
Mobile-first refinement: connection status is in Settings; the chat header/book shortcut and routine roadmap footers are removed. Current-action reminder guidance remains in the editor.

Fresh native screenshots were opened with the prior implementation in dark and light appearances, including keyboard, multiline input, large Dynamic Type, and landscape. One icon-scaling correction was visually confirmed. See ../design-qa.md for evidence and limits.

narrative.overview:
The native app pairs a subdued rural landscape and weathered infrastructure with warm paper and a quiet charcoal field. The contrast gives reminders a tangible place for review while conversation remains open and readable. The selected first expression is the Activity-led Field Ledger recorded in [the native direction contract](Design/direction.md) and [approved composition](Design/approved-activity.png).

Native iOS structure carries navigation, controls, typography, and transitions. Brand is expressed through the palette, imagery, spacing, and restrained metadata. The dark appearance has a warm light counterpart; the reminder paper remains light in both. The configurable companion name and saved conversation supply the content.
keyCharacteristics: Full-page artwork with adaptive charcoal or warm-light washes.
Real paper texture behind actionable reminder content.
System typography with Dynamic Type and SF Symbols.
Native tabs, navigation stacks, forms, sheets, and confirmation dialogs.
Honest connection, saved-copy, pending-message, and reminder states.

rules.name: The Adaptive Ground Rule
rules.body: Bind main text and tint to FieldStyle.ink, supporting text to FieldStyle.secondaryInk, reading surfaces to FieldStyle.surface, and page washes to FieldStyle.ground. Reserve FieldStyle.olive for connection indicators; each binding selects its light or dark variant at runtime.

rules.name: The System Reading Rule
rules.body: Use SwiftUI text styles and their native Dynamic Type behavior; preserve system metrics instead of substituting fixed point sizes, custom fonts, or web type tokens.

rules.name: The Native Frame Rule
rules.body: Let `TabView`, `NavigationStack`, system safe areas, and sheet presentation own the application frame; compose content within that frame.

rules.name: The Material Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep app content flat and let the landscape, real paper grain, tonal fills, and system materials establish depth.

rules.name: The Explicit State Rule
rules.body: Every action uses current model state; status text and symbols explain whether the Mac is reachable and whether a reminder is actually scheduled.

dos: Do use the adaptive native palette and semantic system text styles.
Do retain real landscape and paper assets with their provenance.
Do preserve native tabs, navigation stacks, forms, menus, sheets, and safe-area behavior.
Do allow reminder titles and stored time zones to grow with Dynamic Type.
Do pair status color with readable text and native symbols.
Do keep reminder confirmation explicit and edits subject to fresh approval.
Do distinguish a saved offline copy from current Mac state.
Do keep the native design documentation scoped to `ios` while Prism remains the web system.
donts: Don't replace native typography or navigation with the web app's fonts or controls.
Don't rasterize text, controls, system chrome, or decorative slogans from the approved mock.
Don't replace `ReminderPaper` with a flat color and describe it as the same material.
Don't freeze text to a screenshot's point sizes or shrink it to retain a fixed card height.
Don't add voice, phone notifications, Apple Reminders sync, or other capability controls before they exist.
Don't present illustrative conversation, dates, or connection telemetry as saved user data.
